d: "A knock at the door, a strange sound in the backyard or an animal where it shouldn't be. That's when Turtleman's kind of work begins! From slippery snakes and stubborn turtles to raccoons and mink, these wildlife calls bring a variety of unusual creatures into the picture. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, teams up with Neal James to tackle these unexpected animal encounters, taking on challenging wildlife rescue, animal catching and wild animal removal missions.
